network_enforcement: Every kernel subprocess runs through Bubblewrap with --unshare-net, a read-only host filesystem, only its disposable module directory writable, and a cleared environment with fixed locale, timezone, umask, and one Lean thread. Host-side tool, hash, and Git checks make no network request but are policy-isolated rather than namespace-isolated.
scope_boundary: Network-isolated trust-zero replay of fresh local oleans against the pinned shared warm dependency cache. The recipe validates the frozen statement, conditional composition, zero-dimensional proof, proof-phase conditional declarations, anchor ingredient probes, and a separately written same-worker zero-dimensional reconstruction importing only Statement. M0600-S-DIMZERO remains only a provisional mapping to a planned registry fingerprint; M0600-T-ENGINE and the exact root remain open. Complete transitive trust/provenance, cold empty-cache reproduction, and distinct-runner independent verification are not claimed.
